build_ImageVAE: build an ImageVAE instance with a 3-channel AutoencoderKL model for image encoding and decoding
build_PoseVAE: build a PoseVAE instance with a 6-channel AutoencoderKL model for pose data encoding and decoding
encode_image_with_ImageVAE: encode an RGB image tensor into a 16-channel latent representation using ImageVAE encode property
decode_latent_with_PoseVAE: decode a 16-channel latent tensor back into a 6-channel pose tensor using PoseVAE decode property
inspect_VAE_config: inspect the VAE config, device, downscale_factor, and latent_dim properties of ImageVAE or PoseVAE
